Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment uses a highly specialized double-digestion (Trypsin + IMPa) and dual-fragmentation (HCD + EThcD) approach specifically to resolve O-glycosylation site ambiguity (e.g., T323 vs S325). Standard bottom-up pipelines without O-glycan support and IMPa cleavage rules will fail.
